description: This script automates a series of git operations to test rebasing commits with multi-line commit messages. It sets up initial commits, branches, and performs rebase operations while verifying the commit messages.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive name and a block of commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Pauses to ensure timestamps differ for commits.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
